bio.text: Donald Norcross represents New Jersey's 1st Congressional District and serves on the House Armed Services and Education and Workforce committees.
Born and raised in South Jersey, he is an electrician by trade and was a business agent for IBEW Local 351.
He served for nearly 20 years as president of the Southern New Jersey AFL-CIO and was also a member of the New Jersey Legislature.
He is a lifelong Camden County resident.
